messages:
Alex: Kicking off blue->green shift for release v3.14.0 in eu-west-1. Change window 12:00-12:30 UTC. Plan is phased ramp: 0->5->15->30->60->100 with 2m probes between steps. Will tag canary metrics and set circuit-breaker at 5xx>1% to auto-hold. @SRE please watch latency and cache miss rates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria: copying. pinning v3.13.9 on the router for instant rollback option. I added the rollback link to the release notes doc.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: rollout started -> target: green pool (v3.14.0). Step 0 -> 5% traffic. Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/rollouts/597
Sanjay: Quick ask — can we set the health-probe window to 90s during the ramp? Last time short probes spiked 429s during steady-state warmup.
Alex: good call, Sanjay. OpsBot: set-probe eu-west-1 --path /ping --timeout 90s --retries 3
OpsBot: ok — probe adjusted.
Lina: added an emergency hold tag to the router config so we can pause using the UI without touching weights. Tag: holdback/3.14.0
Maria: I'm going to watch embedding service latency (it's sensitive to cold-starts). If embedding p95 > 500ms we hold at current step.
DeployBot: rollout progressed: 5% -> 15% after 2m probe. Metrics snapshot: p50 latency +8ms, p95 +30ms, 5xx 0.2%
Sanjay: seeing a small uptick in cache-miss rate for model-cache on a subset of nodes, aligns with warming. nothing alarming yet.
Alex: continue to next step but hold 2 extra minutes at 30% to let KV caches stabilize.
DeployBot: progressing -> 30% (holding extra 2m).
DeployBot: metrics at 30% hold (t+4m): p95 embeddings 520ms, embeddings error rate 0.8% (mostly timeouts to downstream aggregator).
Maria: embeddings p95 > 500ms threshold hit. Requesting hold and rollback plan checklist now.
Alex: hold traffic shift. good catch. rolling back to 15% temporary while we triage. DeployBot: executing rollback to 15%...
DeployBot: rollback complete -> 15%. Notifying observability and incident channels.
Sanjay: digging into aggregator timeouts — looks like one region had a regen job and saturated I/O. I'll scope which hosts, ETA 6-8m to drain.
Lina: setting router hold flag so no automatic retries during this triage. Command: /router set-flag holdback/3.14.0 true
Maria: updating release notes: "PAUSE during ramp due to embedding aggregator timeouts; rolled back to 15% while mitigating". Adding postmortem bullet.
Alex: decision tree: if after drain and retry success we retry from 15% -> 30% with longer probe (3m). If failures reoccur, we abort and revert fully to blue (v3.13.9). Everyone ok?
Sanjay: fine. I'll remove the saturated nodes from LB once drain finishes.
DeployBot: manual trigger available: /deploy resume-rollout 597 --from 15% --next-step 30% --probe 180s
Lina: once Sam's (Sanjay) drain completes, I'll flip the hold flag off and we can use the manual trigger. Also added a short circuit-breaker rule: if 5xx > 0.5% for 2 consecutive probes -> auto-revert to previous weight.
Maria: +1. I've exported the canary trace set to the release doc for quick diffs.
OpsBot: nodes 3/12 on eu-west aggregator drained, I/O back to normal on those. ETA 4m for remaining.
Sanjay: remaining nodes drained. re-running smoke tests on embedding aggregator.
Sanjay: smoke tests pass. no 5xx on aggregator.
Alex: good — proceed with cautious resume. Lina, remove hold flag and we'll resume via manual trigger.
Lina: holdback/3.14.0=false
DeployBot: running manual resume -> stepping to 30% with 3m probe.
DeployBot: 30% reached. Probe running...
DeployBot: probe complete: p95 embeddings 460ms, 5xx 0.15%, CPU stable.
Maria: I'll monitor for 15m post-step and then give greenlight for 60% step if stable.
Alex: agreed. leave notifications on. Thanks all for quick response. Adding this thread link to the release notes and tagging for the post-release retro. :white_check_mark:
